name: Potions & Paws
source:
Potions & Paws is a short and sweet visual novel with point & click elements. The player takes on the role of a fantasy animal shelter employee who is tasked with matching each pet to their perfect partner.

[from [url=https://beaniebabysnails.itch.io/potions-paws]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
Potions & Paws是一部简短而甜蜜的视觉小说，带有点击元素。玩家扮演一个幻想动物收容所员工的角色，他的任务是为每只宠物匹配他们的完美伴侣。

[来自[url=https://beaniebabysnails.itch.io/potions-paws]itch.io[/url]]
